name: Project Delete
description: Delete a project ENTIRELY — the doc, its subcollections, and all its project_id-scoped work/plans/approvals. Prime-only; dry-run by default; refuses structural and depended-on projects.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When an operator asks to delete, remove, or tear down a project entirely (not merely archive it) — removing its record and all of its accumulated work.
